targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-737b is a VALID test (z_world guard GREEN: 4/4 world_encoder tensors moved, max_abs_delta 0.103) and its null does NOT discriminate the policy-learning axis. ppo_ree_latent scored 0.233 D3 foraging competence and the matched ppo_raw_obs control 0.567, both below the 1.0 floor AND below the run's own random-walk anchor of 0.933, while a local-view greedy reading the same 5x5 field scored 48.05 and the oracle 57.2. The manifest's own criteria_non_degenerate.ppo_ree_latent_beats_random_floor_at_d3 is false. A trained learner scoring below random walk has not been shown to lack capacity; it has been shown to be optimising something else. V3-EXQ-734's survival column quantifies it: vanilla PPO survives 175.0 steps vs the greedy oracle's 20.4 while foraging 17x less, so the return is dominated by episode survival and survival is maximised by not foraging. V3-EXQ-792/780 corroborate from the other side: a BC-installed raw_view policy reaches 20.933 and decays to 11.667 under unconstrained RL but holds at 0.778-0.871 under a KL anchor. NOT substrate_ceiling and NOT an observability ceiling -- 738/780/792 have already shown the observation interface carries the information.

cluster_pattern.shape: Every absolute / negative-control criterion passes (oracle 57.2, local-view greedy 48.05, bias-head reproduces the D0 deficit) and every discrimination criterion fails, across three structurally different learners (bias-head, actor-critic, PPO) and two observation interfaces (raw obs, z_world) -- with every learner scoring BELOW the run's own random-walk anchor of 0.933 at hazard-free D3.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: A failure invariant across learner AND representation is a property of neither -- it is a property of the objective they share. The training return is dominated by episode survival (vanilla PPO survives 175.0 steps vs the greedy oracle's 20.4 while foraging 17x less), and survival is maximised by not foraging. Every learner is optimising the objective it was given correctly; the objective is not the foraging objective the DV scores. Corroborated from the other side by V3-EXQ-780/792: a BC-installed policy reaches 20.933 and decays to 11.667 under unconstrained RL but holds at 0.778-0.871 under a KL anchor, so the policy class can represent competent foraging and RL refinement destroys it.
